title: HDFC Business Regalia First credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A lighter Regalia First variant tailored for small and medium businesses, offering travel rewards, milestone bonuses, and lifestyle privileges at a lower annual fee.

benefitRows.name: Swiggy
benefitRows.description: Upto 20% Discount on Partnered Restaurant at Swiggy Dineout
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the Swiggy app or website with your registered account. Browse available dining offers, select meals or restaurants, and apply the relevant offer at checkout. Pay via your HDFC Business Regalia First credit card to benefit from premium dining rewards and savings.
